# Frosted glass refresh

## Contract
- Base: ba09ad50f5540d5b6af8a2dcbb6f167dbde3ea20. Local branch design/elegant-motion-20261006.
- R1 frontend interaction and visual refresh. Astra High design owner; Sol implementation; fresh Astra High review required.
- Latest user direction explicitly supersedes DESIGN.md's no-glass and restrained-motion rules. Preserve lavender/chrome/lime identity, current artwork bytes, demo disclosures, full capsule links, existing detail functionality and five unboxed footer links.
- Deliver a simpler, polished frosted-glass interface across discovery, detail and shared shell. Strong typography, generous whitespace, transparent layered surfaces, restrained chrome edges. Use high-quality choreographed entrances, purposeful scroll reveals and responsive interaction motion, without scroll hijacking or perpetual distracting loops.
- Preserve zero/one/multiple/filter/expired/exhausted states and all backend/contract/authorization behavior. No fabricated chain activity. Do not touch financial logic or resolve outstanding policy choices.
- Animation must clean up on navigation, respond to live reduced-motion changes, keep controls immediately usable, and leave content visible when animation cannot run. Motion should use transforms/opacity, with a static lightweight mobile composition.
- Responsive acceptance widths 320, 390, 768, 1440 and 1920. No horizontal document overflow, all controls operable, loaded artwork uncropped. Keyboard focus and accessible names preserved.
- Existing web tests, TypeScript, production build; contract regression/fuzz run if available; live browser direct route/filter/mobile/footer checks; independent candidate review. Record evidence and remaining limits.
- Authorized local edits/tests/commits only. No push, PR, merge, deployment, funding, ownership changes or Library uploads.

## Baseline
- Fresh clone in previously empty workspace. No prior local changes; no repository AGENTS.md found.
- Remote review and main still at handover SHAs. No open PRs. Latest review CI success; GitHub Vercel status success.
- Shared Vercel preview redirects to login, so unauthenticated visual verification is blocked. Use local build.
- Current implementation uses Next 15, React 19, plain CSS and lottie-react, Space Grotesk/IBM Plex Mono. Broad pill controls and heavy chrome compete with artwork; oversized technical readout dilutes discovery. Existing tests and statuses must remain authoritative.
